summary: Inline Partners is a family-run Hunters Hill (Sydney) firm offering bookkeeping, accounting, tax advisory and CFO services, with a Philippines-based workforce. David Mah Chut is Managing Director and Director, and describes it as a small firm with a large firm offering. Bookkeeping, including bank reconciliations, is sold on monthly fixed pricing.

hooks.text: Fixed-fee bookkeeping including bank reconciliations means reconciliation hours hit Inline's margin directly.
David's 'small firm with a large firm offering' line: automation is how a small team delivers that.
Offshore (Philippines) team plus review by directors: review time on reconciliations.

risks.text: LinkedIn shows 9-10% YoY employee decline at the firm; small team (about 10), so budget may be limited.

gaps: No public posts, podcasts or news by David or the firm found; no job ads found; no Xero partner tier confirmed.
